 Vivo Y600 could launch as a rebranded S2 FE with a 10000mAh battery
 By 
 Mudassir Kamran 
 Modified Oct 22, 2026 17:32 IST 
 Vivo Y600 could launch as a rebranded S2 FE with a 10000mAh battery (Image via Vivo) 
 Vivo has officially teased the upcoming Vivo Y600, highlighting its focus on battery life with a massive 10,000mAh BlueVolt battery. The company has also showcased its endurance capabilities through a Guinness World Records achievement for a continuous mobile phone livestream lasting 32 hours and 37 minutes. 
 Ad 
 Meanwhile, leaks suggest the Y600 could share its hardware with the Vivo S2 FE. Vivo has yet to reveal its complete specifications and pricing
 Note : The article is based on leaks and speculation.

 Vivo has officially teased the upcoming Vivo Y600 in China, highlighting its massive 10,000mAh BlueVolt battery and a Guinness World Records achievement. 
 The smartphone is scheduled to launch on October 30, 2026, with a design and specifications that could resemble an existing Vivo model. The company has yet to reveal the complete specifications or pricing details.
 Similar to the Vivo Y600 Pro , its biggest highlight is its 10,000mAh battery, which powered a continuous mobile phone livestream lasting 32 hours and 37 minutes. The endurance test earned Guinness World Records recognition on August 11, 2026. 
 Ad 
 According to leaks shared by tipster Experience More on Weibo , the Y600 could feature a MediaTek Dimensity 7300e processor, a 50MP primary rear camera, and 44W wired charging. The device is also expected to offer IP68 and IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance. However, Vivo has yet to confirm these specifications officially.
 The Vivo Y600 could be a rebranded version of the Vivo S2 FE . However, the company has not confirmed this connection.
 Ad 
 The Y600 may not launch in India under the same name. Vivo has already launched the S2 FE in India, featuring a 10,000mAh battery and the same Guinness World Records achievement. Indian buyers may therefore have to consider the S2 FE instead of waiting for a separate Y600 launch.
